derivedYearModel.classificationNote: measured-anchored: each cell is the median same-day cross-sectional 1-out->2-out ratio (2028/2027 while current=2026) over both vendor pick markets and every archive date; applying it one further year out (2-out->3-out) is an extrapolation no market evidence can test today, so the family stays PRIOR, never MEASURED/VALIDATED. The surface is additionally CONSTRAINED at load time — see monotonicityConstraint — which does not make it measured.

evidence.note: idpTradeCalc's pick board is frozen across the window, so its 34 daily copies carry the evidential weight of ONE independent observation per cell (the cell medians still pool both providers' rows arithmetically - the frozen board simply pins its provider's median); ktcSfTep drifts (cell sd <= 0.021)

evidence.rejectedAlternatives: future-tier trend extrapolation (~0.75-0.80, fitted shape with zero observations of the target quantity); scraper pickAnchors R5/R6 (its own model, measured non-monotonic R4->R5 > 1.0)

derivedYearModel replaces the retired offsetDiscounts curve
(1.00/0.82/0.66/0.53 + fallbackBase 0.80) whose offset-3 entry was
the only live one: audit V-12/C-11 measured it as an uncalibrated
prior applied to a cloned price, ~37% below every observed vendor
year-step cell. The step is applied AT INJECTION relative to the
TEMPLATE year (compounding step^gap for multi-year gaps), so the
cloned per-source values, the blend, the confidence inputs and the
published value all carry one consistent derivation. Vendor-priced
years still take NO discount (audit T-3/C-2 - their prices already
encode the term structure; pinned by
tests/api/test_pick_year_discount_gate.py).
